title: LeCAR-Lab/dial-mpc
abstract:
Official implementation for the paper "Full-Order Sampling-Based MPC for Torque-Level Locomotion Control via Diffusion-Style Annealing". DIAL-MPC is a novel sampling-based MPC framework for legged robot full-order torque-level control with both precision and agility in a training-free manner.

# DIAL-MPC: Diffusion-Inspired Annealing For Legged MPC ICRA 2025, Best Paper Finalist [[Website]](https://lecar-lab.github.io/dial-mpc/) [[PDF]](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Z39MCvnl-Tdraon4xAj37iQYLsUh5UOV/view?usp=sharing) [[Arxiv]](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.15610) [ ](https://github.com/google/jax) [ ](https://opensource.org/licenses/Apache-2.0) This repository contains the code (simulation and real-world experiments with minimum setup) for the paper "Full-Order Sampling-Based MPC for Torque-Level Locomotion Control via Diffusion-Style Annealing". DIAL-MPC is a sampling-based MPC framework for legged robot ***full-order torque-level*** control with both precision and agility in a ***training-free*** manner. DIAL-MPC is designed to be simple and flexible, with minimal requirements for specific reward design and dynamics model. It directly samples and rolls out in physics-based simulations (``Brax``) and does not require reduced-order modeling, linearization, convexification, or predefined contact sequences. That means you can test out the controller in a plug-and-play manner with minimum setup. ## News - 05/19/2025: 🫰 New demo for ball-spinning on finger can be run with `dial-mpc --example allegro_reorient`. - 04/24/2025: 🎉 DIAL-MPC made into the best paper final list of ICRA 2025. - 11/03/2024: 🎉 Sim2Real pipeline is ready! Check out the [Sim2Real](#deploy-in-real-unitree-go2) section for more details. - 09/25/2024: 🎉 DIAL-MPC is released with open-source codes! Sim2Real pipeline coming soon! https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f2e5f26d-69ac-4478-872e-26943821a218 ## Table of Contents 1. [Install](#install-dial-mpc) 2. abstract_zh: DIAL-MPC是一种新颖的基于采样的模型预测控制（MPC）框架，用于足式机器人的全阶扭矩级控制，在无需训练的情况下同时实现精确性和敏捷性。该框架受扩散模型启发，通过退火过程直接在高维状态空间中采样并滚动仿真（基于Brax物理引擎），无需降阶建模、线性化、凸化或预定义接触序列。DIAL-MPC设计简洁灵活，对特定奖励设计和动力学模型要求极低，支持即插即用。该工作荣获ICRA 2025最佳论文最终提名。
tldr_zh: 无需训练的采样MPC框架，实现足式机器人全阶扭矩级精确敏捷控制。
cover_zh: 不用训练就能让机器人跑得又稳又准？这个采样MPC框架做到了！

judge.reason: ICRA 2025最佳论文入围，训练无关的全身力矩级MPC，开源代码含仿真与真机部署。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出 DIAL-MPC，一种受扩散模型启发的退火式采样 MPC 框架：在 Brax 物理仿真中对完整动力学直接采样并滚动展开，通过扩散式迭代退火优化动作序列，无需降阶模型、线性化或训练，即可实现力矩级全阶腿足运动控制。


# 一、动机

> 现有腿足机器人 MPC 依赖降阶建模、线性化、凸化或预定义接触序列，难以在力矩级全阶控制中同时兼顾精度与敏捷性；强化学习虽可端到端，但需大量训练且奖励设计困难。


# 二、方法

> 提出 DIAL-MPC，一种受扩散模型启发的退火式采样 MPC 框架：在 Brax 物理仿真中对完整动力学直接采样并滚动展开，通过扩散式迭代退火优化动作序列，无需降阶模型、线性化或训练，即可实现力矩级全阶腿足运动控制。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 1）获 ICRA 2025 最佳论文提名（Best Paper Finalist）；2）在 Unitree Go2 上完成 Sim2Real 部署；3）额外支持 Allegro 手转球（ball-spinning）等灵巧操作 demo，证明方法可插件式迁移至不同机器人平台；摘要未给出具体量化指标。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限在于采样式 MPC 的实时计算开销较大、性能依赖物理仿真精度，Sim2Real 仍存在动力学差距；启发是扩散式退火可作为一种通用的无训练序列优化范式，其插件化设计便于快速迁移到其他机器人本体与任务。
